sufficiency_note: Development starting material only. Qualify each new asset component and its scope independently.
purpose: Official retained interface examples plus a labelled synthetic asset scenario. All implementation and measurement remain pending.
original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.
Every mandatory artifact exists or maps to agreed equivalent sections; preserve original evidence and disclose unresolved failures.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.
Activation, authorization and existing platform boundaries remain enforced; no new owner, command or queue authority is introduced.
Named supporting reviewers reproduce the relevant contract/case check and record findings/disposition.

asset_research_plan.decision: For one Ubuntu profile and a small approved read-only probe set, map structured missing fields to a deterministic, budget-bound plan. Start with a simple rule or enumeration; keep full collection as a working fallback.
questions: Which approved probe supplies each asset field, and which fields cannot be collected in the current scope?
Can deterministic coverage/cost rules reduce unnecessary collection versus always running full inventory?
How should stale evidence, missing permissions, identity conflict and exhausted budgets prevent or limit a plan?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Compare full inventory and a sensible fixed-rule selector with the proposed selector. Pin the same initial snapshots, target scope, case set and available probes for every method.
cases: A small approved probe covers the gap — Configured cost units are design examples, not measured seconds or savings; only a validated returned observation can resolve the gap.
The requested operation is not approved — The planner cannot introduce a command or widen execution authority.
No candidate fits the available budget — Return an honest unresolved case rather than exceeding the bound.
consumers: C21: version-bound approved probe plans to turn into bounded collection intents.
C22: selected/rejected probes and costs for baseline/ablation comparison.
A11/P08 reviewers: optional structured plan consumption and existing typed-envelope validation; no AI or executor ownership transfer.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous reviews gap semantics and baseline outcomes; Omar reviews typed-envelope compatibility and denied operations.
asset_research_plan.start: Activate after C22 freezes independent cases/core baselines and the approved adapters expose separately callable field probes. If only one full-inventory operation exists, record the limitation rather than inventing selective collection.

implementation_reference.interface: plan_probes(asset_revision, gap_keys, approved_capabilities, budget, policy_revision) → selected_probe_ids, covered_gap_keys, estimated_cost, unresolved_gap_keys, reasons. A plan is not a collected result.
implementation_reference.baseline: Compare full inventory and a sensible fixed-rule selector with the proposed selector. Pin the same initial snapshots, target scope, case set and available probes for every method.
metrics: Actual elapsed time, attempts, transferred bytes where available, and gaps actually resolved after collection.
Critical identity/freshness errors and unresolved cases; estimated policy cost is reported separately from measured resource cost.
Include connection/setup, retries, failed probes and fallbacks in total cost.
creative: Try a transparent greedy rule, bounded enumeration or another justified selector; freeze the configuration before final comparison.
Investigate when batching or full inventory is cheaper than selective probes. A negative result can reject the candidate and retain the baseline.

steps: Use C22’s frozen cases and a delivered approved capability map; verify field-level probes really exist.
Define measurable resource budgets separately from estimated selection weights.
Implement one simple deterministic selector tied to asset, policy and capability revisions.
Send typed plans through P08; recheck identity/scope/expiry before any existing adapter executes.
Record validated results, failures and all overhead; unresolved gaps stay unresolved.
Run paired baseline/candidate comparisons and publish positive, tied or negative outcomes with uncertainty/limitations.
